facts.title: Barton Fink

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: What begins as an enticing studio contract soon spirals into an inescapable nightmare within the stifling confines of an eerie hotel room.
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Lured to 1940s California to write for the movies, a celebrated New York playwright checks into a strange hotel and encounters the grim, disorienting realities of the Hollywood studio system.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Darkly funny, suspenseful, and heavy, balancing steady dramatic pacing with an increasingly surreal, high-friction atmosphere.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Directed by Joel and Ethan Coen, this sharp blend of comedy, drama, and neo-noir thriller turns creative frustration into an unsettling, razor-sharp look at commercial filmmaking.
